description: The chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” illustrates side-by-side score percentages for two models across multiple datasets/metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks labeled (left to right) GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with labels rotated diagonally; the axis label reads “Dataset and Metrics.” The vertical axis is a linear numeric scale labeled “Score (%)” with values spanning roughly 0 to 80+ and tick marks shown at regular 10-point intervals. Each category has two adjacent bars corresponding to the legend at upper right: LLaMA-3-8B-it in blue and Ours (Iterative RLHF) in orange. Approximate bar heights are: GSM-8K ~80 (blue) and ~80 (orange); MMLU ~66 (blue) and ~65 (orange); HumanEval ~61 (blue) and ~64 (orange); TruthfulQA shows only an orange bar at ~60 with no visible blue bar; ARC ~59 (blue) and ~64 (orange); MBPP ~61 (blue) and ~60 (orange); LC AlpacaEval-2 ~23 (blue) and ~31 (orange); MT-Bench (×5) ~41 (blue) and ~42 (orange); Chat-Arena-Hard ~20 (blue) and ~29 (orange). The bars are grouped by benchmark (two bars per group where present), there is no stacking, and there are no additional annotations or visual emphasis beyond the color coding; the categories appear in a fixed listed order rather than being sorted by value.
